hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ "$d" != "." ] && [ ! -f "$d/.prettierignore" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if [ -f "$d/.prettierignore" ]; then pnpm exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown --ignore-path "$d/.gitignore" --ignore-path "$d/.prettierignore" "$f"; else pnpm exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f"; fi; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
